mentions.name: Porting WebKit to Fil-C
mentions.description: This project ports WebKit, specifically the JavaScriptCore JavaScript engine, to Fil-C, a memory-safe C compiler. JavaScriptCore currently builds in the JSCOnly configuration but panics on startup, primarily because JSC makes extensive use of uintptr_t to carry pointers, which triggers Fil-C's safety checks.
mentions.problem: JavaScriptCore builds but panics on start, with most panics stemming from JSC's extensive use of uintptr_t as a carrier of pointers.
